trigger: Player steps onto the windy 3rd-floor balcony overlooking the high-altitude gap.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: That gap is huge! My developer legs definitely can't jump that far!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, momentum is conserved. You keep forward speed when you swap in mid-air!

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Conservation of momentum! Tag-hop mid-jump and carry the velocity! Dost, let's go!
